text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ――I did it...! I... actually won!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why? I feel so much happier than 
ever before...
choice_data_list:
Because you ran desperately and seized it 
yourself.

Because you ran with everything you had 
and seized it yourself.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Like, "Someone like me could never..." or, 
"Who am I to even try..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All of that was gone today. Because in my 
heart, I was screaming the whole time for 
it to reach them...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —That was brilliant, Nature-san.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: McQueen! Ryan-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I gave it my all as well. ...It seems I 
still have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yet should we have another opportunity to 
compete, I will certainly not lose next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Guess I gotta get back into 
shape! Thanks, Nature-chan!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No, no, thank you...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Those two were so refreshing right to the 
end. They were already looking ahead.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even if she loses, she's already looking 
to the next one. She reaches her hand out, 
determined that next time will be the one.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Teio was the same. That's why she's so 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I'd put limits on myself. 
Thinking no matter how hard I tried, this 
was as far as I could go.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
3rd place, exactly. Deep down, I gave 
up... thinking I couldn't go any further.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, that wasn't enough. If I wanted to 
reach the light, I had to keep on 
believing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If this third place came from aiming 
straight for first, then surely... it will 
lead to the next victory.

Nice Nature is looking forward, too. Even 
when competing on the biggest stages, she 
won't shy away anymore.

"To that race, where she can gain even 
more confidence and prestige...!"
choice_data_list:
Why don't we run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
next?

Why don't we run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
next?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The historic and traditional "Tenno Sho." 
Me, in a race like that...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...No, no, no. Why are you getting so 
timid?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"It's not 'I wonder if it's okay to 
run'... I have to psych myself up and say, 
'I AM running!'"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Let's dive in. Into the grand autumn 
stage...!

—And so, it was decided that we would take 
on the Tenno Sho (Autumn) to determine the 
strongest middle-distance runner!
